name: sql-query-builder-pro-lite
description: Browser-only visual SQL query builder: SELECT with joins, subqueries, CTEs and UNION, plus INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, with an optional SQL Lab that runs SQL in an embedded SQLite database stored in your browser. Never connects to a database server.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --sourcemap --format=iife --target=es2022 --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/sqlbuilder.js && node scripts/build-worker.mjs && node scripts/stamp-assets.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:mobile && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
